correctness.rationale: The proof derives an exact necessary-and-sufficient profile criterion from induced connectivity and domination in complete multipartite graphs, then obtains the polynomial by inclusion-exclusion. The finite check is explicitly not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of a standard domination invariant on the full complete-multipartite family, a family already singled out in published work for the scalar parameter. It determines every feasible set and all cardinality counts, thereby strengthening a minimum-only result in a way that can support reliability, random-subset, and coefficient questions. The result is not an arbitrary finite slice or a mere renaming.
